Tier list · patch 26.22

Based on patch 26.22 Emerald+ ranked data from op.gg and lolalytics. Tier lists only tell you what's strong on average. A champion you know well beats a high-tier champion you don't.

Mid laneBot lane
S
EkkoTop win rate in mid: 53.9% on lolalytics (S+) and 52.2% on op.gg, Emerald+ 16.22.
KatarinaS+ on lolalytics (53.1%), top 3 on op.gg, and counters many popular mages (Ahri, Syndra, Veigar).
AhriMost-picked mid (11.5%) and still about 53% on lolalytics. Ranked #1 mid on op.gg.
A
Vladimir53.3% on lolalytics (S-), 51.5% on op.gg. Hard-counters Lux, Yasuo and Ahri.
Twisted FateS on lolalytics (52.5%). Safe pick with global map pressure, and his R now also reveals untargetable units (26.21).
Hwei53.0% win rate on lolalytics (S) and 51.5% on op.gg, on low pick rates.
LeBlancA+ on lolalytics and #4 on op.gg with a 19% ban rate. Bullies immobile mages.
Fizz53.4% on lolalytics (A+), #5 on op.gg. Counters Syndra and Malzahar.
